history.summary: Plan completed and committed (cbd2b49): cross-cutting shape; P1 adds architectureProducer and amends the guide in JenkinsPipelineUtils, P2-P4 migrate the 78 producers (50 deploy and 25 app producers become one call, Ansible/DockerImages/IoTSupport become full declarative files) as local commits listed in a producer ledger for the test phase's one-go push, and P5 updates the review records; verification.json has 15 criteria, with V14 (KubeCoderDeploy's producer reaching prd) owed until the next KubeCoder promotion. Three doc and template items outside the plan's scope went to the close-out report (P1, P2, B1).

Requirements map 1:1, the task shape holds and citations check out, but five blocking findings: P1 names only some of the guide rules a one-call file breaks (PROP-3/4, CHK-1, TIME-1, POD-1, GRAN-7 and the guide's framing go unnamed); V10 is a doc-truth universal; P1's claim that the linter promise 'stays true' is false for a one-call reference file, and V11 depends on it; IoTSupport's producer keeps a SEC-5 violation while V01 and P4 say it follows the guide; and running the UnderfloorHeatingController build after the collector is re-enabled breaks V09's single collector build.
